Prediction Lab · XSharp — Totals (vs book line)

Prediction Lab (PL) and XSharp are compared against the book’s Over/Under line.

  • 3/3 = PL and XSharp agree with the same side of the book line
  • 2/3 = only one leans; the other sits on the book line (line counted as the third outcome)
  • 1/3 = opposite disagreement (each graded on its own side)
  • PL = Prediction Lab’s published Over/Under pick
  • XSharp = Over if its projected total is above the book line; Under if below
  • Books = the book’s total line only — it is not a third pick

0-0 = none in that window; 0-0-N = pushes only.

Understanding These Results

The results displayed on this page reflect all tracked picks generated by the model. Performance is measured using standard sports betting metrics such as win percentage, units gained or lost, and overall return on investment.

These metrics provide a clearer picture of performance beyond simple win/loss records.

Why Transparency Matters

All results are recorded without modification or filtering. This ensures that users can evaluate the model based on complete and accurate data rather than selective highlights.

Transparency is a core part of the approach, allowing users to build trust through consistent tracking.

Reviewing Picks Alongside Results

For the best understanding of performance, results should be viewed alongside the original picks. This gives context to how the model operates and how outcomes compare over time.

You can explore daily picks pages to see how selections were made and how they performed.
